art_direction: 霜白薄荷 · 小小得意: 霜白底，薄荷青眼与微扬短嘴，自然俏皮。
composition_variation: Clean frosty white field with a whisper of cool gray. Fresh mint-turquoise irises with soft black pupils, graceful almond eye contours and sweeping upper lids. One eyelid a little lower, both eyes looking gently toward the viewer. A delicate head tilt makes the pair lively while proportions remain harmonious. One crisp little white reflection each. Two tiny pale gray brows above, and a very short mouth with just a subtly lifted end below the eyes. Charming, poised, slightly pleased with itself, never a broad cartoon grin. Keep all shapes spare and refined.
style_inspiration: Two user-provided chat attachments were observed for broad style: minimalist eyes, black or ivory field, sparse color, handmade matte edges. Original expressions and layouts were described in text. No attachment was uploaded as binary model input and no watermark-removal edit was performed.
